proof.headline: An automation we run ourselves.
proof.caption: The lead system above is an automation we built and run for our own business: it searches Google Maps for businesses with plenty of reviews and no website, checks each one, and drafts a message for every lead. Some steps run on their own and some are run by hand. Want one like it, pointed at your own customers? It is quoted like any other automation.

faq.a: Most admin that repeats: moving an enquiry from your inbox into your calendar and invoices, chasing quotes that went quiet, sending reminders and confirmations, or finding and checking new leads like the lead system on this page. Tell us the job and we tell you honestly whether it is worth automating.

faq.q: Does it send messages for me?
faq.a: Only if you want it to. By default, anything that goes to a customer is drafted for you to approve with one tap. It is your name on it.

faq.q: What do I own after delivery?
faq.a: The automation or the agent is yours. The files are handed over when you pay on delivery.

Because we do not know what yours needs to do yet. Tell us the business and the job, and you get a fixed price and a delivery date in writing before any work starts. If it needs to answer the phone, that is the AI receptionist, priced separately, from $499 setup, then $149 a month.
